data.heading: Join the team
data.description: Build the world’s most accurate loudspeakers in Port Perry, Ontario.

roles.title: Acoustic Engineer
roles.text:
Design and measure new loudspeaker systems from concept to production.

You have a degree in acoustics or electrical engineering and experience with measurement and prediction tools.

roles.title: Applications Engineer, Touring
roles.text: Support rental partners and touring productions across Europe, from system design to show day.

roles.title: CNC Machinist
roles.text: Machine cabinet parts on our 5-axis CNC line to tight tolerances.

roles.title: Embedded Software Developer
roles.text: Build firmware for the XG Series and Milan network devices.
